department: Department of Physics (Division of Particle and Nuclear Physics page)

deadline.value: Division PhD openings are advertised individually on Lund's vacancy page; there is no fixed application date.
deadline.quote: All openings for PhD studies are advertised on the Lund University page for vacancies

gre_subject.value: The division page does not mention the GRE Physics subject test.

supervisor.value: The division page describes close work with supervisors but sets no rule on agreement before admission.
supervisor.quote: PhD students work in close collaboration with their supervisors and colleagues

funding.value: The Particle and Nuclear Physics division admits only students with full financing, and admitted students receive a monthly salary. This covers that division only.
funding.quote: Once admitted, the PhD student receives a monthly salary within a regular employment in Sweden

also.quote: The Division only accepts PhD students with full financing for the whole four-year period

entry_route.value: Lund's general rule is a second-cycle qualification, or 240 credits including 60 at second-cycle level.

notes: Only the Particle and Nuclear Physics division page was reached as an official physics page; the Department of Physics admissions page could not be found by search, and the other divisions are not covered. The LTH Physics subject plan is not used here.
